notes.title: Hotfix (v1.0.3 - 11/12/20)
notes.content:
Yesterday the first hotfix patch for Dustoff Z went live!

This patch contains the following bug fixes:
[list]
[*] “Scrap them all” achievement.
[*] Distance count at the endless levels.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

We are working on further patch updates focusing on a few more reported bugs.

If you have any issues to report feel free to contact our support directly by sending an email to support@zordixpublishing.com
